non_claims: Supersession is a current-state marker only; it does not alter or unfreeze the byte-frozen freeze JSON/MD/receipt, LegacyVsMovementGap, or the dispositions amendment.

0 UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER is local movement-inventory evidence and does not grant promotion, candidate acceptance, canonical write, authority transfer, live-provider, cutover or legacy-retirement authority.
risks: All historical state documents remain byte-identical; consumers must read this status marker before using their line-state counters as current state.
The P1 addendum and this status file are new evidence, not reviewed by the independent all-lines double-gate review that recorded the original P1 findings.
